messages.subject: MCFA: model did not converge
parts:
Hello,

Currently, I try to run a MCFA in lavaan following a powerpoint presentation I found about it. Unfortunately, I keep receiving messages about convergence issues.
The data are clustered in 44 teams (here called "Vkst") in a long format. At the same time, I measured all latent variables (PA, SK, K) two times with the same items. Therefore, I set the loadings of the items equal across time (indicated by the letters, eg. a*). However, even without equal loadings, it does not converge.
Does anybody know how to fix this?

Thank you in advance!!!

My code looks like this (model2 is supposed to be the independent model; model 3 should be saturated at the between level):
model2 <- '
  level: 1
    PA1 =~ RF1PA1 + a*RF1PA2 + b*RF1PA3 + c*RF1PA4 + d*RF1PA5 + e*RF1PA6
    PA2 =~ RF2PA1 + a*RF2PA2 + b*RF2PA3 + c*RF2PA4 + d*RF2PA5 + e*RF2PA6
    SK1 =~ RF1SK1 + f*RF1SK2 + g*RF1SK3
    SK2 =~ RF2SK1 + f*RF2SK2 + g*RF2SK3
    K1 =~ RF1K1 + h*RF1K2 + i*RF1K3 + j*RF1K4
    K2 =~ RF2K1 + h*RF2K2 + i*RF2K3 + j*RF2K4
  level: 2
    RF1PA1 ~~ RF1PA1
    RF1PA2 ~~ RF1PA2
    RF1PA3 ~~ RF1PA3
    RF1PA4 ~~ RF1PA4
    RF1PA5 ~~ RF1PA5
    RF1PA6 ~~ RF1PA6
    RF1SK1 ~~ RF1SK1
    RF1SK2 ~~ RF1SK2
    RF1SK3 ~~ RF1SK3
    RF1K1 ~~ RF1K1
    RF1K2 ~~ RF1K2
    RF1K3 ~~ RF1K3
    RF1K4 ~~ RF1K4
    RF2PA1 ~~ RF2PA1
    RF2PA2 ~~ RF2PA2
    RF2PA3 ~~ RF2PA3
    RF2PA4 ~~ RF2PA4
    RF2PA5 ~~ RF2PA5
    RF2PA6 ~~ RF2PA6
    RF2SK1 ~~ RF2SK1
    RF2SK2 ~~ RF2SK2
    RF2SK3 ~~ RF2SK3
    RF2K1 ~~ RF2K1
    RF2K2 ~~ RF2K2
    RF2K3 ~~ RF2K3
    RF2K4 ~~ RF2K4
'
fit.change.6factor.equal.indie <- sem(model2, data = only.mcfa, cluster = "Vkst", std.lv = T, verbose = F)
summary(fit.change.6factor.equal.indie, fit.measures = T)
